Name: The Return of the Boarding House
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]Amazingly, Trent has given me permission to reupload the copy of his old Boarding House mod that I still had for my personal playthrough![/size]

[size=4]This mod adds a new area accessible from the upper left corner of the bus stop by the minecart (walk toward the trees). This version is compatible with Downhill Project![/size]

[size=4]The Boarding House adds 3 new NPCs: Joel, who runs the Boarding House proper; his daughter Sheila, who runs the nearby Buffalo Ranch; and deep in the new mines and valley area, an explorer named Gregory. Gregory and Sheila and both romanceable.[/size]

[size=4][s]As of right now this mod is as Trent left it off; that is, it requires a few frameworks that are almost obsolete, but still work. I plan to phase these out with future updates. The Boarding House will also be available as housing for future new NPCs: if you are a mod creator interested in housing an NPC at the Boarding House, shoot me a message here or on Discord![/s][/size]

[size=4]As of 5.0 most dependencies have now been phased out: This mod now only requires Content Patcher, Custom Companions, and Farm Type Manager![/size]

[size=4]The Boarding House will also be available as housing for future new NPCs: if you are a mod creator interested in housing an NPC at the Boarding House, shoot me a message here or on Discord! [/size]


[size=4]Enjoy![/size]

[size=4]~Like my work? [url=https://ko-fi.com/silvermoonchan]Buy me a coffee![/url] ☕ [/size]
